description: Static world objects of map0_s00 (Old Silent Hill - intro sequence): 2 objects, drawn in file order. An object is drawn while the player is in one of its "zones" (each {"x": [...], "z": [...]} lists 40 m cells along that axis: cell c holds 40c..40(c+1) m; no zones = everywhere) and every flag of "flags_set" is set and every flag of "flags_clear" is clear (event flag names, e.g. the pickup flags). "name" is the object's id for scripts and mods, "model" its model (at most 8 characters, the map's or an item model), "position" in metres and "rotation" in degrees (x, y, z). "script": true lets world_objects.lua and events.lua move, turn, re-model or hide the object. Wheel1 and Wheel2 are script objects: world_objects.lua tilts them and spins them about z. A mod's maps/map0_s00/world_objects.json changes or adds objects by name.
